description: Wolfram Research's software document format renders interactive Mathematica code as graphical, customizable documents in a standalone player or browser environment.
title: Wolfram Computable Document Format (CDF)

description: The WLEIS is a 16-item self-report assessment developed by Wong and Law for measuring four dimensions of emotional intelligence: self-emotional appraisal, others' emotional appraisal, regulation of emotion, and use of emotion.
title: Wong and Law Emotional Intelligence Scale (WLEIS)

description: Wooclap is an interactive classroom-response platform made by Wooclap that enables synchronous learner responses, live result visualization, and assessment activities including Script Concordance Tests.
title: Wooclap

description: A standardized achievement subtest measuring applied mathematical problem-solving and early numeracy, developed and published as part of the Woodcock-Johnson assessment system by Riverside Insights.
title: Woodcock-Johnson Tests of Achievement—Applied Problems subtest

description: A speeded perceptual-substitution assessment in which examinees classify labeled forms or symbols into corresponding categories, developed by Woodworth and Wells and adapted here for children.
title: Woodworth-Wells substitution test

description: A historical composite assessment scale that combines percentile-ranked mental and physical test results into age- and sex-normed scores for educational and vocational guidance.
title: Woolley composite adolescent measurement scale

description: A timed psycholinguistic assessment instrument that elicits and analyzes learners' spontaneous word associations to diagnose the organization and integration of concepts in a knowledge domain.
title: Word Association Test (WAT)

description: Word Engine is a commercial online adaptive flashcard platform for vocabulary learning that uses IRT/CAT diagnostics and item selection alongside retrieval practice and spaced rehearsal.
title: Word Engine

description: Word Generation is a school curriculum developed by researchers and educators to build middle-school students’ academic vocabulary and civic discourse through weekly dilemma-based units.
title: Word Generation

description: A prototype eye-tracking application created by Kai Kunze and colleagues that estimates the number of words a person reads from gaze data recorded by the SMI iView X.
title: Wordometer app for the SMI iView X eye tracker

description: WordStream Maker is a no-code software tool developed by Huyen N.
title: WordStream Maker

description: A supervisor-completed instrument for assessing occupational-therapy students' fieldwork competence across professional knowledge and skills, clinical reasoning, ethics, interpersonal relationships, professional development, and work performance.
title: Work Competence Report (WCR)

description: A workforce-oriented framework organizing AI literacy into six domains—Technical Knowledge, Practical Implementation, Analytical Skills, Interpersonal and Communication Skills, Ethical Evaluation, and Adaptive Skills—developed by Zachariah et al.
title: Workforce AI literacy framework of six skill and competency domains

description: A computer-administered assessment developed by ebilities that measures children's working-memory accuracy and confidence-based metacognitive monitoring across increasing difficulty levels.
title: Working Memory Power Test for Children (WMPT)

description: A comprehensive integrated-services strategy implemented by community colleges to support low-income students and students of color through financial, career, and other coordinated supports.
title: Working Students Success Network (WSSN)

description: World History Project is a free, online, year-long high-school world-history curriculum made by the OER Project, combining readings, videos, historical-thinking activities, and teacher guidance.
title: World History Project curriculum

description: A supplementary prekindergarten curriculum developed by the World of Words project that builds vocabulary, concept knowledge, and science content knowledge through topic-centered conversations and shared book readings.
title: World of Words (WOW)

description: WorldWide Telescope is an interactive scientific data-visualization and aggregation software package developed by Microsoft Research, with astronomical imagery, a 3D Universe, and narrated interactive tours.
title: WorldWide Telescope
